training.selection: Training-only four-fold CV; reserved holdouts and fresh points never fitted.
training.use_gate: For each energy/target/CF: holdout median APE <=2%, p95 APE <=5%; report all failures.

validation_integrity.scope: Exact source hash, train-only coordinates and normalized training labels. Not physical validation.

robustness.scope: Conditional operating/background-factor scenario sensitivity, not physical reliability. No pass/fail threshold. GP, kinetic and thermophysical uncertainty are not jointly propagated.
robustness.candidate_scope: 312–348 °C in 2 °C steps; 6–19 m in 1 m steps. Full perturbation boxes remain inside the prediction domain.
robustness.variability_definition: Population standard deviation of the finite scenario ensemble (ddof=0). CV=100*SD/abs(mean); relative P05-P95 span=100*(P95-P05)/abs(P50). Zero denominators are explicitly unavailable.

quantiles.position: p*(N-1), linearly interpolated between neighboring sorted values

method_metadata.zero_denominators: null with explicit reason; no replacement epsilon
method_metadata.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks; exact score ties use midranks
method_metadata.ordinal_rank_assignment: Existing numpy.argsort default (quicksort in this runtime); not stable for exact ties
method_metadata.top1_tie_policy: One ordinal first place per draw; exact top-score ties are not given fractional credit. Their order may depend on NumPy version.
method_metadata.sampling_interpretation: Nested-prefix frequency drift is descriptive only; it establishes neither model accuracy nor sufficient Monte Carlo sample size.

rank_agreement.statistic: Pearson correlation of average ranks (Spearman); exact ties use midranks

STD.interpretation: Finite-sample diagnostics under the specified scenario distribution. Prefix stability is not a convergence guarantee, prediction confidence or physical reliability.

rank_agreement.statistic: Pearson correlation of average ranks (Spearman); exact ties use midranks

HR.interpretation: Finite-sample diagnostics under the specified scenario distribution. Prefix stability is not a convergence guarantee, prediction confidence or physical reliability.

limitations: Fixed-background climate calculation, not a new openLCA run or complete multi-impact LCIA.
Native cal/s converted using 4.1868 J/cal; archived website results remain unchanged.
Actual Celsius is used; archived manuscript labels used Kelvin minus 273.
One archived 330 °C / 10 m inventory offset is retained as an exception, not fitted away.
Dense grid cells are surrogate predictions, not additional Aspen simulations.
